entries.title: Joshua 24:1
segments: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers. And they presented themselves before God.

entries.title: Joshua 24:2
segments: And Joshua said to all the people, So says the LORD God of Israel, Your fathers lived Beyond the River in times past, Terah the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor, and they served other gods.

entries.title: Joshua 24:3
segments: And I took your father Abraham from Beyond the River, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed and gave him Isaac.

entries.title: Joshua 24:4
segments: And I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau. And I gave Esau Mount Seir for his own, but Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt.

entries.title: Joshua 24:5
segments: I sent Moses also, and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them. And afterward I brought you out.

entries.title: Joshua 24:6
segments: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt. And you came to the sea, and the Egyptians followed after your fathers with chariots and horsemen to the Red Sea.

entries.title: Joshua 24:7
segments: And they cried to the LORD, He put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea on them and covered them. And your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt. And you lived in the wilderness a long time.

entries.title: Joshua 24:8
segments: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites who lived on the other side Jordan. And they fought with you, and I gave them into your hand so that you might possess their land. And I destroyed them from before you.

entries.title: Joshua 24:9
segments: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you.

entries.title: Joshua 24:10
segments: But I would not listen to Balaam. And he still blessed you. And I delivered you out of his hand.

entries.title: Joshua 24:11
segments: And you went over Jordan and came to Jericho. And the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. And I delivered them into your hand.

entries.title: Joshua 24:12
segments: And I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, the two kings of the Amorites, not with your sword, nor with your bow.

entries.title: Joshua 24:13
segments: And I have given you a land for which you did not labor, and cities which you did not build, and you live in them. You now eat of the vineyards and olive-yards which you did not plant.

entries.title: Joshua 24:14
segments: Now, then, fear the LORD, and serve Him in sincerity and truth. And put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt, and serve the LORD.

entries.title: Joshua 24:15
segments: And if it seems evil to you to serve the LORD, choose this day whom you will serve, whether the gods which your fathers served Beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you live. But as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.

entries.title: Joshua 24:16
segments: And the people answered and said, Far be it from us to forsake the LORD to serve other gods.

entries.title: Joshua 24:17
segments: For the LORD our God [is] He who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage. And He did those great wonders in our sight, and kept us in all our way in which we went and among all the people through whom we passed.

entries.title: Joshua 24:18
segments: And the LORD drove out from before us all the people, even the Amorites who lived in the land. We will also serve the LORD, for He [is] our God.

entries.title: Joshua 24:19
segments: And Joshua said to the people, You cannot serve the LORD, for He [is] a holy God. He [is] a jealous God. He will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.

entries.title: Joshua 24:20
segments: If you forsake the LORD and serve strange gods, then He will turn and do you harm, and destroy you after He has done you good.

entries.title: Joshua 24:21
segments: And the people said to Joshua, No, but we will serve the LORD.

entries.title: Joshua 24:22
segments: And Joshua said to the people, You [are] witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen the LORD, to serve Him. And they said, [We are] witnesses.

entries.title: Joshua 24:23
segments: And now put away the strange gods among you, and incline your heart to the LORD God of Israel.

entries.title: Joshua 24:24
segments: And the people said to Joshua, We will serve the LORD our God, and His voice we will obey.

entries.title: Joshua 24:25
segments: And Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

entries.title: Joshua 24:26
segments: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone and set it up there under an oak by the sanctuary of the LORD.

entries.title: Joshua 24:27
segments: And Joshua said to all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness to us, for it has heard all the words of the LORD which He spoke to us. It shall therefore be a witness to you, lest you deny your God.

entries.title: Joshua 24:28
segments: And Joshua sent away the people, each man to his inheritance.

entries.title: Joshua 24:29
segments: And it happened after these things, Joshua, the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, [being] a hundred and ten years old.

entries.title: Joshua 24:30
segments: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-serah in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.

entries.title: Joshua 24:31
segments: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, and who had known all the works of the LORD that He had done for Israel.

entries.title: Joshua 24:32
segments: And the bones of Joseph, which the sons of Israel brought up out of Egypt, they buried in Shechem, in a piece of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. And it became the inheritance of the sons of Joseph.

entries.title: Joshua 24:33
segments: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died. And they buried him in a hill [belonging] to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.
